google_apps_script_extension_records.summary: Keep Apps Script server-side JavaScript separate from browser and Node assumptions.
google_apps_script_extension_records.operational_boundary: Server-side Apps Script functions execute in Apps Script, while user-facing HTML executes in the browser context provided by HtmlService.
safe_use: Use Apps Script services only in server-side files
Use browser APIs only in client HTML
Create explicit client/server adapters
unsafe_assumptions: Using fs/process/npm packages as if in Node
Using document/window in .gs files
Treating Apps Script triggers as ordinary browser events
checks_or_diagnostics: Label each file as server-side Apps Script, HtmlService browser HTML, shared generated script, or local build artifact.
Verify service/API methods, quotas, auth scopes, trigger behavior, deployment access, and file handling against current Google documentation.
Use small probes or tests for platform-bound behavior before bulk automation.
